key_concepts: [url]How to Bend Any Object In Blender in 1 Minute^^https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tMHwdXB5xVo[/url]
Learn how to use the Simple Deform Modifier.

content: Add a Cube to the scene, and give it some Loop Cuts running along the y-axis (Image 1). Add a Simple Deform Modifier (Image 2). Change the type to Bend (Image 3).

image.src: Blender/Blender In Minute/Blender Tips/Bend any Object/bend-01.jpg
image.caption: Image 1 - Adding a Cube to the scene and giving it some Loop Cuts running along the y-axis

image.src: Blender/Blender In Minute/Blender Tips/Bend any Object/bend-02.jpg
image.caption: Image 2 - Adding a Simple Deform Modifier

image.src: Blender/Blender In Minute/Blender Tips/Bend any Object/bend-03.jpg
image.caption: Image 3 - Changing the type to Bend

content: Add an Empty to the scene (Image 4). Make the Empty the Origin of the Simple Bend Modifier (Image 5). Select the Empty and [k]R,Y,90[/k], you should see the modifier adapt (Image 6). Update the cube, changing the degree of bend, updating the size (Image 7).

image.src: Blender/Blender In Minute/Blender Tips/Bend any Object/bend-04.jpg
image.caption: Image 4 - Adding an Empty to the scene

image.src: Blender/Blender In Minute/Blender Tips/Bend any Object/bend-05.jpg
image.caption: Image 5 - Making the Empty the Origin of the Simple Bend Modifier

image.src: Blender/Blender In Minute/Blender Tips/Bend any Object/bend-06.jpg
image.caption: Image 6 - Selecting the Empty and rotating it 90 degrees in the y-axis to see the modifier adapt

image.src: Blender/Blender In Minute/Blender Tips/Bend any Object/bend-07.jpg
image.caption: Image 7 - Updating the cube by changing the degree of bend and updating the size
